The Montran Instant Payments Gateway (IPG) enables participants in an instant payments ecosystem to support high volumes of instant payments in a high availability 24x7 environment. The gateway complies with PSD2 Open API requirements and offers a unified API based on the ISO 20022 messaging standard. It supports Payment Initiation Service Providers (PISP) for payment initiation and Account Information Service Providers (AISP) for account information access. The system supports credit transfers, request to pay, bulk payments, and QR code-based instant payment initiation. It natively processes ISO 20022 pacs, pain, and camt messages and supports active-active deployment across clouds.
